reasoning_content:
Docker is running but maybe build wasn't started. The docker-compose.yml has port 3000 exposed but it gets used by supabase-rest. Let me check if we can build differently.

Actually, the Docker build is taking too long. For now, let me try a simpler approach - just check if the current tsx server works via external port by testing work-2.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
import time

client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Restart the tsx server
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pkill -f 'tsx src' 2>&1 || true")

time.sleep(2)

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/server && nohup npx tsx src/index.ts > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &")

time.sleep(20)

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000")
print("HTTP:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
